name: A5: A-Ressha de Ikou 5
summary: Released in December 1996 in Japan for Windows 95, this was the first A-Train game to use 3D graphics with a PowerVR graphics accelerator.

name: A 5 Year Old's War Game
summary: End a war that has lasted for many pages. Command your armies on a turn-based strategy map, then lead your crayon drawn soldiers into real time battles
